controls: Replay identical saved Top-12 candidates and source chunks for all 128 dev questions. Both arms use the same 2000-body-character cap. No embedding, reranker, domain routes or gold-based selection. Whole chunks only; duplicate chunk IDs removed; overlapping text not merged.
neighbor_policy: Visit each ranked seed, then immediate next and previous chunks in the same source ordered by position. Skip any whole chunk that does not fit; no expansion if its seed cannot fit. Adjacent chunks can be outside the dense candidate pool. No cross-source or cross-version adjacency.
generation: Same previously selected nine questions, application generate method and current model/prompt. If both arms have identical ordered chunk IDs, call once and mark response reuse; do not treat reuse as independent repetitions. Alternate arm order by question. Compare these newly generated arms, not historical answers.
decision: Keep failures and regressions. Character cap is a reproducible proxy, not an equal-token constraint. Review actual input tokens and answer quality. No automatic promotion to production; held-out test unused.
